# MONOLITH (03 · monolith)

A brutalist type foundry with a live variable-font specimen — width and weight follow your cursor.

- **Technique:** VARIABLE FONTS
- **Tags:** brutalist, typography, bold, grid, red, monochrome, editorial, tech
- **Best for:** type foundries; design studios; developer tools; bold agencies
- **Fonts:** Anybody, Space Grotesk, Space Mono
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anybody:ital,wdth,wght@0,50..150,100..900;1,50..150,100..900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300..700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f1efe9 · #111111 · #ff2b00
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/monolith/` (Template.astro, content.ts, interactions.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* monolith — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --bg: #f1efe9;
  --blk: #111111;
  --red: #ff2b00;
  --mute: #777777;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --disp: "Anybody", sans-serif;
  --grot: "Space Grotesk", sans-serif;
  --mono: "Space Mono", monospace;
}
```

## Signature effects
- `interactions.ts`
  - `initHeroType(el: HTMLElement)` — Hero wordmark: pointer X sweeps the width axis (50–150), pointer Y the weight axis (900–200), eased.
  - `initScramble(rows: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Scramble each row's `[data-scramble]` text when the pointer enters the row.
  - `initTester(text: HTMLElement, inputs: Iterable<HTMLInputElement>)` — Live type tester: three range inputs (`data-axis` = wdth | wght | size) drive the editable text.
  - `initCountUp(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Count `[data-count]` numbers up from 0 (ease-out cubic, 1.4s) the first time they are half visible.
  - `initTicker(el: HTMLElement)` — Cycle `el` through its `data-messages` (JSON array) every 4.2s.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<a>/<span>/<sup> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/**
 * Specimen look for a catalog row's name, set in CSS with variable-font axes:
 * brute = wide black, narrow = condensed, bone = hairline, slab = wide italic, mono = monospace.
 */
export type FamilyLook = 'brute' | 'narrow' | 'bone' | 'slab' | 'mono';

export interface Family {
  look: FamilyLook;
  name: string;
  /** Three meta chips under the name (e.g. "18 styles", "Variable", "2024"). */
  meta: [string, string, string];
}

/** A range input of the type tester. */
export interface Slider {
  label: string;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  value: number;
}

export interface Fact {
  /** Counts up from 0 when scrolled into view. */
  value: number;
  label: string;
}

export interface Plan {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  /** Small suffix after the price, e.g. "/ STYLE". */
  unit: string;
  features: string[];
  cta: Link;
  /** Marks the plan as the featured one (inverted colors) and shows this badge. */
  badge?: string;
}

export interface SectionHead {
  title: string;
  /** Mono index at the right of the sticky section header. */
  idx: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo in the top bar; the <sup> is tinted red. */
  logoHtml: string;
  /** Messages cycling every 4.2s in the top bar (the first shows initially). Hidden below 900px. */
  ticker: string[];
  /** Section anchors available: #catalog, #tester, #license. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** The two giant lines; the second is red. */
    line1: string;
    line2: string;
    ariaLabel: string;
    hint: string;
    meta: { label: string; value: string }[];
  };
  /** Items of the inverted ticker band; the dot separators are added automatically. */
  marquee: string[];
  catalog: { head: SectionHead; families: Family[]; specimenLabel: string };
  tester: {
    head: SectionHead;
    /** Initial editable text. */
    text: string;
    width: Slider;
    weight: Slider;
    size: Slider;
    noteHtml: string;
  };
  facts: Fact[];
  license: { head: SectionHead; plans: Plan[] };
  footer: {
    giantHtml: string;
    addressHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered only when the Template receives `showcase`. */
  showcase?: { chipLabel: string; chipHref: string; footerHtml: string };
}
```

- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style monolith --out <dir>`
